units: <cite ref="Shabbat 75a:5">Sabb. 75ᵃ</cite> <he>פ׳ בכלל דישה</he> opening the purple snail (squeezing the fluid out) is an act coming under the category of threshing.
<cite ref="Genesis 9">B’resh. 9</cite>, a. e. <he>פ׳ פ׳</he> several wounds, contrad. to <he>חבורות</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 9:6:6">Y. Kil. IX, end, 32ᵈ</cite> <he>היו בראשו פ׳</he> (not <he>בראשי פצעיות</he>) if one has several wounds on his head.
